name: VC Trader AI Dispatch Strategy Experiment (Propose)
description: Stages a strategy-first experiment dispatch proposal for human review (catalogue kinds: vbt_backtest, vbt_prop_sim, vbt_walkforward, nautilus_backtest, nautilus_prop_sim, nautilus_walkforward, nautilus_prop_walkforward, stage_b_bundle_run; the vbt_/nautilus_ prefix must match the strategy's runtime). Calls the propfirm_manager BFF at /api/v1/openclaw/stage with tool_name dispatch_strategy_experiment. PROPOSE_ONLY per ADR 0078 - it never dispatches directly; the staged descriptor is reviewed + Applied in the chat, which reuses the v3 dispatch_experiment service and threads the optional origin_signal_id learning-loop link.
